findings.quote: Nearly all of it is shielded now, and the town's total installed output has come down.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick C): A is eliminable from form alone as a double absolute ('every light in the valley', 'nothing ... any light upward') that no real code achieves, and C is then the only moderately hedged option ('Nearly all') among three sweeping claims (B 'has never established', D 'enough of them declined'). The hedging asymmetry pulls to C materially above chance, but B and D remain substantive alternative outcomes a passage would decide. Not a form-alone leak.

findings.quote: Nearly all their light fell inside one narrow band, which the observatory could screen out at little cost.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind pick B): low-pressure sodium emitting essentially at one narrow line, and observatories filtering that line cheaply, is standard astronomy knowledge, so a domain-aware solver picks B without the passage. But A (efficiency as the replacement motive), C (total light comparison) and D (filter cost in the blue) are all substantive, writable positions with no formal tell separating them; the mechanism is domain expertise, not structure. Routed to adjudication per calibration.

findings.quote: That it is too small to be told apart from other things that moved over the same years.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick D): C is eliminable from form as an over-general absolute ('cannot establish whether a lighting code has worked anywhere'), and A is a single-cause attribution to one event. The stem itself supplies the magnitude ('about three percent'), which primes the measurement-noise reading in D. B stays substantive, so the item is not decided blind, but two eliminations plus the stem's own small-number framing put a solver well above chance.

findings.quote: That a greenhouse kept lit all winter is the one thing now standing between the ridge and a usable sky.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick C): B is eliminable from form as a singleton absolute ('the one thing'), and A and D rest on the same underlying claim that light over the valley rose through the decade, which weakens both as a main-idea key. C is then the only option framing a metric-versus-reality mismatch, the shape main-idea keys usually take. A and D are separable claims a passage could distinguish, so this is an asymmetry lean rather than a form-alone leak.

findings.quote: That a name is chosen because no buyer is in a position to prove it inaccurate.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick B): a 3-1 asymmetry is visible without any domain knowledge - A (tested on customers), C (describes the shade closely enough) and D (defended against trade standards) all make the name answerable to something external, while B alone says the name is chosen precisely because it is unfalsifiable. The odd-one-out plus C reading as a bland truism pushes a solver above chance. It is not a form-alone leak: A and D are ordinary commercial practices a passage could equally well have keyed, so the pull is partly genre expectation that a short feature reports a surprising rule.

findings.quote: That the arrangement of the dimples has no bearing on the way a ball flies.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick C): D is eliminable from form as an absolute denial that is also plainly false in the world, and A's monotonic 'deeper dimples give longer flight' is contradicted by ordinary aerodynamics knowledge. The stem's framing ('implied', 'that ball makers advertise') primes a debunking key, which C supplies as the only hedged option ('can be smaller than'). B remains a substantive alternative, so the item is not decided blind; the mechanism is a mix of one formal absolute and golf-aerodynamics world knowledge.

findings.quote: De äldsta tornen är genomgående de mest utsmyckade, medan de som restes efter andra världskriget är avskalade.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick C): B is eliminable from form as a sweeping chronological universal ('genomgående'), and C/D are a near-mirror pair stating the same terrain-to-ornament relation, C hedged and restricted ('förefaller', 'men enbart där staden i övrigt var låg') against D's unrestricted 'oavsett vilka andra höga byggnader staden hade'. The hedged member of such a pair is the usual key, which lifts a solver above chance. C and D are nonetheless contradictory substantive claims about whether other tall buildings mattered, and only the passage settles that, so this is not a form-alone leak.

findings.quote: Att vattenytan i behållaren skulle ligga ett bestämt stycke ovanför den högsta kran tornet försörjde.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind pick A): that a water tower's height is set by the hydrostatic head needed above the highest tap served is textbook waterworks engineering, so a domain-aware solver picks A without the passage. B is additionally weak because it answers reservoir volume rather than the stem's 'hur högt'. C and D are substantive engineering alternatives with no formal tell against them; the deciding mechanism is domain knowledge, not structure.

PARTIALLY (blind pick D): the stem names the objector's discipline, and exactly one option (D, wealth from railway and workshops as the confounder) is an economic explanation while A, B and C are generic methodological objections any scholar could raise. A reader with no domain knowledge sees that discipline-to-option match from form alone, which puts a solver above chance. It stops short of a leak because an economic historian could equally well raise C's survivorship objection about a seventeen-object catalogue, so the passage still decides. Worth adjudication as a stem-side signal.

findings.quote: Sedan tornen tagits ur bruk har samtliga byggts om till bostäder eller till utsiktsplatser för besökare.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick B): two options fall from form alone - C on the universal 'samtliga', and A on a category error, since a water tower is not 'i praktiken främst bostäder och arbetslokaler'. That leaves B, the only epistemically hedged synthesis ('av skäl som materialet bara delvis reder ut'), against D, which is a substantive hedged attribution a passage could support. Two firm eliminations plus the hedging asymmetry, but the B-versus-D contest is genuine, so not a form-alone leak.

findings.quote: Att de äldre invånarna rörde sig allt mindre i staden var skälet till att kommunerna stängde toaletterna.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick C): A is eliminable from form as a reversed causal direction - it makes reduced movement the cause of the closures rather than the effect, which no study of this shape would report - and B is a scope claim about a figure the stem never introduces. C is then the survey finding that matches the stem's framing. D remains a substantive alternative affected group, so the item is not decided blind.

findings.quote: Att kommunerna borde bygga bemannade toaletter i varje kvarter i innerstaden, öppna dygnet runt.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick A): B falls from form as a maximalist demand ('varje kvarter', 'dygnet runt') of the kind written as filler, and C is non-responsive to the stem, which asks for an objection to the toilets disappearing rather than a claim about the real cause. A is then the columnist-shaped cost-shifting argument. D is still a writable objection, so this is an elimination lean rather than a leak.

findings.quote: Matematikläxan var den läxa som oftast lämnades ogjord av eleverna.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick: none): D is eliminable from form as non-responsive - the stem asks what the time measurements showed, D reports completion rates - and C, the null result, is weakened by the presence of an exact mirror pair (A and B), which signals the author cared about the direction. That narrows the field to two, materially better than chance, but A and B are exact opposites and nothing in the stem or options decides between them, so the passage remains necessary.

findings.quote: Det största problemet i skolan är att lektionstiden inte räcker till för kursinnehållet.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick D): C falls from form as an off-topic superlative ('det största problemet i skolan') that answers a question the stem did not ask, and B is a policy prescription rather than a statement the text could be said to match. A overreaches by turning a study of homework time into a claim about what pupils learn. D is then the measured thesis that fits the study design. B is a real position in the Swedish debate rather than a caricature, so three eliminations of unequal strength - a lean, not a form-alone leak.
